labelChirho: on behalf of, for the sake of
descriptionChirho: Benefactive or substitutionary preposition with genitive: acting for the sake of, in the interest of, or in place of someone. The predominant NT usage, especially in sacrificial/soteriological contexts (Christ dying ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν). Multilingual confirmation: arb مِنْ أَجْلِ, heb בְּעַד, hin के लिए, kor 위하여, spa por. See Matt 5:44; Luke 22:19-20; John 6:51; 10:11,15; 11:4,50-52; 13:37-38; Rom 5:6-8; 1 Cor 11:24; 2 Cor 5:14-15,21; Gal 1:4; 2:20; Eph 5:2,25; 1 Tim 2:6; Heb 2:9.

Preposition with genitive indicating the topic or subject matter under discussion or consideration, equivalent to περί in many contexts. Distinguished from the benefactive sense by the absence of personal benefit or substitution. Arb عَنْ, heb עַל / בְּנוֹגֵעַ לְ, hin विषय में, kor 에 대하여, spa acerca de. See John 1:30; Rom 9:27; 2 Cor 1:8; 8:23-24; 9:2-3; 12:5,8.

Preposition with accusative expressing spatial or hierarchical superiority: a position, rank, or status higher than something else. Often in comparisons of master/servant, teacher/student. Arb فَوقَ, heb מֵעַל, hin से बड़कर, kor 위에, spa sobre. See Matt 10:24(x4),37(x2); Luke 6:40; Eph 1:22; 3:20; Phil 2:9.

Preposition with accusative expressing comparative excess or surpassing: going beyond a standard, limit, or point of comparison. Used for 'more than,' 'beyond what is written,' 'surpassing' in degree. Arb أَكثَرَ مِن / فَوقَ, heb מֵעַל / יוֹתֵר מִ, hin से अधिक / से परे, kor 보다 / 넘어서, spa más que / más allá de. See Luke 16:8; Acts 26:13; 1 Cor 4:6; 10:13; 2 Cor 1:8; 12:6,13; Gal 1:14; Phlm 16,21; Heb 4:12.

Adverbial intensifier (often in compounds ὑπερλίαν, ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ, or standalone ὑπέρ as adverb) expressing extreme degree: surpassingly, superabundantly, beyond all measure. Arb أَكثَرُ / فائِقينَ, heb יוֹתֵר / לְמַעְלָה מִמַּה, hin से अधिक / अत्यन्त, kor 더욱 / 넘치도록, spa más / sobreabundantemente. See 2 Cor 11:5,23; 12:11; Eph 3:20; 1 Thess 3:10; 5:13.
